opportunities.title: ClaudeProfileSwitch: Multi-Account, MCP Profile & Quota Guard for Claude Code
opportunities.pain: No built-in multi-account/MCP profile switcher across work and personal projects (#18435: 1,425 upvotes; #27302: 698 upvotes) and abrupt 5-hour session limit exhaustion (#38335: 545 upvotes)
opportunities.solution: Zero-dependency CLI that snapshots/swaps isolated Claude auth + MCP profiles per repo (.claude-profile) and audits local JSONL session token burn against 5-hour quota windows

opportunities.title: ClaudeDiffReview: Copilot-Style Multi-File Diff Review & Hunk Accept/Reject for Claude Code
opportunities.pain: Claude Code CLI modifies multiple files without an interactive hunk-by-hunk Accept/Reject review UI in VS Code like Copilot Edits Review (anthropics/claude-code#33932: 318 upvotes)
opportunities.solution: VS Code .vsix extension that captures pre/post Claude Code file snapshots, renders hunk-by-hunk Accept/Reject/Revert controls, and exports PR diff summaries

opportunities.title: PrismaSqlLens: Offline Prisma-to-SQL Compiler & Non-Destructive Supabase Drift Repair
opportunities.pain: Prisma migrate forces destructive database resets on Supabase schema drift (#19100), lacks offline .getRawQuery() SQL compilation (#5052: 204 upvotes), and lacks serverless VPC migration bundles (#4703: 512 upvotes)
opportunities.solution: Zero-dependency CLI that compiles schema.prisma & query blocks into raw PostgreSQL DDL/SQL offline, generates non-destructive _prisma_migrations SHA-256 drift repair SQL, and bundles serverless migrations

opportunities.title: VaultShield: Static Exfiltration Scanner & SHA-256 Lockfile for Obsidian Plugins
opportunities.pain: Obsidian community plugins run unsandboxed with full Node/Electron fs, child_process, and network access, abused in real-world RAT campaigns (366 HN pts / 229 comments)
opportunities.solution: Local CLI scanner that audits .obsidian/plugins/*/main.js for child_process/eval/exfiltration domains, enforces SHA-256 plugin-lock.json integrity, and diffs updates

opportunities.title: LinearBridge: 1-Click Notion PRD to Linear Sub-Issues & Sync
opportunities.pain: Linear's native Notion integration is read-only link unfurling; teams manually copy-paste PRD checklists into Linear issues or pay for brittle Zapier polling.
opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension injecting a 'Push PRD to Linear' action bar inside Notion that decomposes headings/checklists into Linear parent + sub-issues and syncs status badges locally via user API keys.

opportunities.title: NotionGuestBridge: 1-Click Client Notion Guest Workspace to Claude/Cursor Context & MCP Pack
opportunities.pain: Notion official MCP & OAuth API block Guest users/freelancers completely (makenotion/notion-mcp-server#227: 99 rx, 2026-03) and Claude connector fails to search client Notion links (claude-ai-mcp#356: 29 rx)
opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension operating on the guest's open Notion tab to extract database tables, callouts & nested pages into structured JSON/Markdown MCP context packs with zero Member seat upgrade or cookie theft
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Official Notion MCP rejects guest OAuth; upgrading costs clients paid Member seats; private token_v2 scripts violate Notion ToS and break on auth changes; no official guest extension exists

opportunities.title: WebflowAssetZip: 1-Click Webflow CMS CSV Asset Downloader, Rich-Text CDN Rewriter & 301 Redirect Pack
opportunities.pain: Webflow CMS CSV exports leave all image/file columns and inline Rich-Text HTML tags hotlinked to uploads-ssl.webflow.com, so every image breaks into a 404 when Webflow hosting is canceled.
opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension that parses Webflow CMS CSVs or open CMS collections, downloads and renames every image/asset by item slug, rewrites CSV + Rich-Text HTML CDN URLs to your new host (Framer/S3/R2/WP), and outputs a 301-redirects.csv map.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Webflow Asset Exporter only dumps raw unnamed assets without mapping to CMS slugs or rewriting CSV and Rich-Text HTML tags; generic image scrapers only grab 1 rendered page.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Webflow native 'Export CSV' fails 100% on asset ownership because it only exports hotlinked uploads-ssl.webflow.com URLs that die when the Webflow plan is canceled.

opportunities.title: FigmaTokenBridge: 1-Click Figma Variables & Styles to Tailwind v4 / MUI Theme
opportunities.pain: Figma gates native Variables REST API behind Enterprise ($75/seat/mo), forcing manual copy-paste of tokens into tailwind.config and theme.js (mui/mui-design-kits#10: 99 upvotes)
opportunities.solution: Local-first Chrome MV3 extension that extracts Figma variables/styles into Tailwind v3/v4 @theme CSS, shadcn variables, and MUI theme.js with dark/light mode support

opportunities.title: LinearClientReport: 1-Click White-Label Sprint & Project Status Report Exporter for Linear
opportunities.pain: Agencies and product teams cannot share clean weekly client reports from Linear: Guest users are blocked from exporting, native CSV exports are capped at 250 issues and dump raw internal engineering fields/estimates, and third-party Linear client portals cost -/mo.
opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension injecting a 'Client Report' action into Linear Project/Cycle views that groups issues by status (Shipped, In Progress, Up Next), strips internal engineering labels/estimates/handles, and outputs a white-label HTML/PDF executive report or Markdown changelog.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Breeze.pm, Lindie, and SteelSync cost -/mo recurring and require full workspace OAuth; Linear Business plan costs -/user/mo and still blocks Guest exports.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Linear native 'Cmd+K -> Export issues as CSV' dumps raw internal columns/estimates, caps members at 250 rows, omits attachments (expiring links), and is completely blocked for Guests.

opportunities.title: NotionGitExport: Lossless Notion Tree & Database to Clean Markdown
opportunities.pain: Native Notion Markdown export appends 32-char UUID hashes to every file/folder, flattens database properties, and breaks internal relative links and image paths.
opportunities.solution: Zero-dependency CLI wrapper that strips UUID suffixes, converts database properties into clean YAML frontmatter, rewrites relative links, and localizes assets for Git/Obsidian/Astro.

opportunities.title: LookerTableExport: Full-Scroll Multi-Page Table & White-Label PDF/CSV Report Packager for Looker Studio
opportunities.pain: Looker Studio's native PDF export truncates scrollable data tables to only the top ~15 visible rows (rendering a useless scrollbar screenshot for rows 16-500) and stamps Looker Studio footer branding on client reports.
opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension on lookerstudio.google.com that dynamically unrolls scrollable DOM tables before capture, strips Looker footer chrome, injects an agency white-label header, and exports full-row print-ready PDF views + multi-table CSV/Markdown summary packs.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Looker Studio Pro (/user/project/mo) still truncates scrollable tables in PDF exports; Supermetrics/Swydo cost -/mo; Looker Studio Companion focuses on field editing rather than unrolling scrollable tables for PDF/CSV client packs.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Looker Studio native 'Share -> Download Report (PDF)' cuts off every scrollable table below the fold and includes Google/Looker footer branding.

opportunities.title: ExtProfileLock: Declarative .extensions.json & Env Sync for VS Code
opportunities.pain: VS Code lacks declarative repo-level extension toggling (microsoft/vscode#40239, 1180+ upvotes) and caches stale shell env vars when launched from OS GUI.
opportunities.solution: VS Code extension that reads a repo-committed workspace-lock.json + .env to auto-toggle conflicting extensions and refresh extension host env vars without restarting.

opportunities.title: ClaudeProjectBridge: 1-Click Claude.ai Web Projects Knowledge & Instructions to Repo CLAUDE.md Sync
opportunities.pain: Claude.ai Web Projects do not sync custom instructions or uploaded knowledge files to local repo CLAUDE.md.
opportunities.solution: Chrome MV3 extension exporting Claude.ai Project files to local repo.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: Claude Project Downloader (claudeprojectdownloader.com) & Claude Exporter free Chrome extensions already export entire Claude.ai Projects into ZIPs.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Free Chrome extension Claude Project Downloader already exports all Project files and instructions to a local ZIP in 1 click (solves >=80%).
opportunities.verdict: NO-GO (Kill Switch Triggered: buyer_persona='dev-config' with willingness_to_pay < 6.5 (dev-config audiences prefer free OSS + token workarounds), existing_alternative_saturation < 5 (native export, shared PAT + OSS repo, or 2-min free escape hatch solves >=50%))

opportunities.title: AgentUndoShield: Auto-Checkpoint & 1-Click Undo for Untracked/Dirty Files in VS Code for Codex & Claude
opportunities.pain: AI coding agents run git checkout/clean and wipe untracked or dirty files not yet in Git.
opportunities.solution: VS Code extension snapshotting dirty/untracked files before agent turns.
opportunities.existing_alternatives: AgentCheck (@agentcheck/cli + VS Code extension), claude-code-safety-net, and native .claude/settings.local.json permissions.deny rules already block destructive git commands.
opportunities.free_escape_hatch: Native .claude/settings.local.json permissions.deny rules + free OSS claude-code-safety-net hook block git checkout/clean in 2 minutes.
opportunities.verdict: NO-GO (Kill Switch Triggered: buyer_persona='dev-config' with willingness_to_pay < 6.5 (dev-config audiences prefer free OSS + token workarounds), existing_alternative_saturation < 5 (native export, shared PAT + OSS repo, or 2-min free escape hatch solves >=50%))

opportunities.title: DockerVolumeForge: 1-Command Docker Volume Rename, Clone & Compose v3 Extends Flattener

opportunities.solution: Python CLI wrapping docker volume clone and compose YAML flattening

opportunities.verdict: NO-GO (Kill Switch Triggered: existing_alternative_saturation < 5 (existing native/free tool solves >=80%), diy_resistance < 5 (replaceable by <15-line script/alias))
